1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

nodes.title: GAP FLF2V Storyboard Looper Notes
widgets_values: GAP FLF2V storyboard first/last looper built from the cleaner video_ltx2_3_flf2v base graph. Use Song Range Selector to choose the full render window. If use_loaded_audio is ON, the workflow slices the loaded song to that range; if it is OFF, the same loop runs against silent audio for time-only rendering. Storyboard First/Last Scheduler walks the connected images as overlapping pairs such as 1->2, 2->3, 3->1 until the selected window ends. Storyboard Prompts supplies the positive prompt text for the current segment. Leave unused image slots disconnected.

nodes.title: Motion Track Notes
widgets_values: Official FLF2V first/last loop backbone with sparse-track motion guidance added on the first guide. Edit the motion paths, then the rendered track image drives the first IC-LoRA guide while the official last-frame IC-LoRA branch keeps the endpoint stable.
